items.title: How would you find early users for an AI trading assistant before MVP?
items.raw_excerpt: I’m building an AI analyst desk for retail FX traders. The idea is to split the work of a real FX analyst desk across five LLM agents: macro context, setup comparison, risk review, specialist synthesis, and reflection/audit. The product generates structured market reports that traders can use before making their own decisions. A report may include macro context, strategy candidates, risk notes, entry/SL/TP zones, invalidation conditions, and a suggested position idea. It does not custody user funds, and the current direction is decision support, not auto-execution. The hard part is trust. The MVP is not fully finished yet, and in trading/finance it is very difficult to get people to try a new product without credibility. But to make the product trustworthy, I need feedback from real users.

items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, I’m building AgentWing. The idea is simple: AI agents usually execute work as one long sequence: plan → act → wait → observe → act again → verify → finish That makes agent workflows feel slow, especially when parts of the task do not actually depend on each other. AgentWing adds a director layer that turns one agent task into multiple isolated worker runs. excerpt_i18n.en: From R&D and design to manufacturing, and from supply chain management to customer service, intelligent agents are permeating every aspect of the automotive industry. Ensuring their safety, compliance, and controllability has become a critical challenge for automakers. Currently, Li Auto has deployed AI-powered intelligent assistants across various scenarios within the enterprise, covering multiple real-world business contexts such as security operations, R&D collaboration, and IT services. After thoroughly examining the usage scenarios of intelligent agents, Li Auto's security team identified three major security bottlenecks prevalent in the industry: ambiguous permission boundaries, loss of control over behavioral processes, and an expanding attack surface, all of which severely hinder the large-scale implementation of AI. To address these issues, Li Auto partnered with Volcano Engine to develop a comprehensive "AI Intelligent Assistant Defense-in-Depth System" covering "supply chain security, assistant runtime security, and permission-behavior security." This system compensates for the security shortcomings of open-source AI intelligent agents from the source while enabling enterprise-level unified security management for all AI intelligent agents. The defense-in-depth system provides comprehensive protection for AI intelligent agents. Li Auto's security team collaborated with Volcano Engine to create this solution.

items.title: 权威报告：中国AI云市场爆发，阿里云占比38.1%稳居第一，超二三四名总和
items.raw_excerpt: 5月19日，国际权威市场调研机构英富曼（Omdia）发布最新的《中国AI云市场份额2025》报告，2025年中国AI云市场总规模达567亿元人民币，其中，阿里云在AI IaaS和MaaS两大领域均位列第一，总份额从上半年的35.8%上涨至38.1%，整体稳居第一，超过二到四名总和。   图说：Omdia《中国AI云市场份额2025》阿里云第一   Omdia认为，云计算因为AI大模型的兴起迎来了最深刻的范式变革，因此，中国AI云市场必须要系统性重新衡量。Omdia首次将AI云定义为AI IaaS 和MaaS两大核心领域，其中，MaaS再细分为面向模型再开发的MPS（Model Production Service）以及以tokens消耗为主的MCS（Model Consumption Serivce）。Omdia报告显示，中国AI云市场2025年处于大幅增长阶段，整体市场规模约为567亿元人民币，IaaS占比约69%，MaaS约为31%。整体上看，阿里云市场份额38.1%位列第一，火山引擎、百度云、腾讯云、天翼云分列第二到五名，前五名云厂商市场占比总和超过八成。 AI IaaS仍占AI云市场的大头，Omdia将其定义为支撑AI计算的GPU、存储、网络等资源市场。Omdia报告显示，中国AI IaaS总规模达392亿元，阿里云以38.6%的份额稳居第一，占比远超余下厂商，头部效应尤为明显。Omdia指出，AI IaaS的客户主要集中在自动驾驶、智能座舱、AI for Science等领域，行业壁垒较高；当前竞争核心已从GPU数量转向计算、存储、网络等系统性工程能力，头部厂商需在高性能互联、集群调度编排及推理加速等维度，将GPU利用率维持在90%以上。据了解，阿里云的灵骏智算集群可提供万卡训推一体AI算力，得益于多级亲和性与拓扑感知调度设计，可实现卡间互联路

excerpt_i18n.en:
On May 19, the internationally authoritative market research firm Omdia released its latest report "China AI Cloud Market Share 2025". In 2025, the total size of China's AI cloud market reached 56.7 billion RMB. Alibaba Cloud ranked first in both AI IaaS and MaaS, with its total share rising from 35.8% in the first half of the year to 38.1%, firmly holding the top position and surpassing the combined share of the second to fourth place.  

Caption: Omdia "China AI Cloud Market Share 2025" Alibaba Cloud ranks first  

Omdia believes that cloud computing has undergone its most profound paradigm shift due to the rise of large AI models, necessitating a systematic reassessment of China's AI cloud market. For the first time, Omdia defines AI cloud as two core areas: AI IaaS and MaaS. MaaS is further subdivided into MPS (Model Production Service), focused on model redevelopment, and MCS (Model Consumption Service), primarily based on token consumption.  

According to Omdia's report, China's AI cloud market experienced significant growth in 2025, with a total market size of approximately 56.7 billion RMB. IaaS accounted for about 69%, while MaaS accounted for about 31%. Overall, Alibaba Cloud held the largest market share at 38.1%, followed by Volcano Engine, Baidu Cloud, Tencent Cloud, and Tianyi Cloud in second to fifth place. The combined market share of the top five cloud vendors exceeded 80%.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 19 de mayo, la autoridad internacional de investigación de mercado Omdia publicó el informe "Cuota de mercado de la nube de IA en China 2025". En 2025, el mercado total de la nube de IA en China alcanzó los 56.700 millones de yuanes. Alibaba Cloud ocupó el primer lugar tanto en AI IaaS como en MaaS, con una cuota total que aumentó del 35,8 % en la primera mitad del año al 38,1 %, manteniéndose en primer lugar y superando la suma del segundo al cuarto puesto. Leyenda: Omdia "Cuota de mercado de la nube de IA en China 2025" Alibaba Cloud en primer lugar. Omdia considera que la computación en la nube ha experimentado el cambio de paradigma más profundo debido al auge de los grandes modelos de IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: From May 14 to 16, the 2026 Global AI Terminal Expo and the 7th Shenzhen International Artificial Intelligence Exhibition were grandly held at the Shenzhen Futian Convention and Exhibition Center. With the theme "Terminals Empower the Future, Everything Reborn," the exhibition brought together enterprises across the entire AI industry chain, exploring new industry opportunities around cutting-edge directions such as AI terminal iteration, edge computing, Xinchuang integration, and industry implementation. Jiangyuan Technology was invited to attend the exhibition, showcasing multiple self-developed AI terminal products based on the domestic AI computing power track. On-site, it officially launched the Jiangyuan D20D Intelligent Computing All-in-One Machine and won two industry authoritative awards during the concurrent award ceremony, making it one of the most notable enterprises at this exhibition. The exhibition gathered high-quality enterprises from the entire AI industry chain, showcasing the latest generation of intelligent hardware and computing power solutions, promoting collaborative industry development and technical exchange and cooperation. Leveraging its own R&D capabilities, Jiangyuan Technology brought desktop-level Xinchuang intelligent computing products to the exhibition, providing practical and efficient support solutions for local AI deployment and industry implementation. During the new product launch segment of the exhibition, the Jiangyuan D20D Intelligent Computing All-in-One Machine (Xinchuang Edition) was officially introduced. The entire machine is built on a fully domestic supply chain, equipped with Jiangyuan's self-developed D20 AI accelerator card, featuring core advantages such as 560T high-performance AI computing power, 256GB ultra-large video memory, low power consumption, and silent operation. The D20 supports acceleration for multiple precision models including INT8, FP16, and FP32, and is deeply adapted to intelligent agent application frameworks such as OpenClaw and Hermes, enabling local deployment of Minim.
excerpt_i18n.es: Del 14 al 16 de mayo, la Exposición Global de Terminales de IA 2026 y la VII Exposición Internacional de Inteligencia Artificial de Shenzhen se celebraron en el Centro de Convenciones y Exposiciones de Futian, Shenzhen. Jiangyuan Technology asistió a la exposición, centrándose en el ámbito de la potencia de cómputo de IA nacional, y presentó varios productos de terminales de IA desarrollados internamente. Durante el evento, lanzó oficialmente el equipo integrado de computación inteligente Jiangyuan D20D y recibió dos premios de la industria en la ceremonia de premiación, convirtiéndose en una de las empresas más destacadas de la exposición.

excerpt_i18n.en: On May 18, Baidu released its Q1 2026 financial report, showing total quarterly revenue of 32.1 billion yuan. Baidu's core business revenue reached 26 billion yuan, up 2% year-over-year, exceeding market expectations. AI business revenue accounted for 13.6 billion yuan, representing 52% of Baidu's core business revenue and growing for multiple consecutive quarters. "In Q1, AI business revenue exceeded half of Baidu's core business revenue for the first time, indicating that AI has become Baidu's core growth driver," said Baidu founder Robin Li. "Driven by surging enterprise demand and our differentiated full-stack AI capabilities built over years, AI cloud revenue has shown strong growth momentum. Baidu's AI applications continue to expand their influence among enterprises and individuals, further validating the commercial potential of Baidu's AI innovations. Meanwhile, Apollo Go has maintained triple-digit growth in fully driverless ride-hailing trips and continues to advance international expansion. We believe AI will bring greater value to Baidu in the coming quarters." Full-stack AI capabilities stand out, AI cloud grows 79% rapidly. Baidu Intelligent Cloud has been fully upgraded to a new full-stack AI cloud for large-scale intelligent agent applications, with comprehensive evolution of Agent Infra and AI Infra capabilities, further strengthening end-to-end collaboration from underlying computing power to intelligent agent applications, providing a solid foundation for intelligent agent development. In terms of computing hardware, Kunlun Core P800 has completed large-scale validation, delivering multiple 10,000-card clusters.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 18 de mayo, Baidu publicó los resultados financieros del primer trimestre de 2026, que muestran unos ingresos totales trimestrales de 32.100 millones de yuanes. De ellos, los ingresos del negocio de IA fueron de 13.600 millones de yuanes, lo que representa el 52% de los ingresos del negocio general de Baidu, y han crecido durante varios trimestres consecutivos. "En el primer trimestre, los ingresos del negocio de IA de Baidu superaron por primera vez la mitad de los ingresos del negocio general, lo que indica que la IA se ha convertido en el motor central de Baidu", afirmó Robin Li, fundador de Baidu. "Impulsados por el aumento de la demanda empresarial y las capacidades diferenciadas de IA de pila completa que hemos desarrollado durante años, los ingresos de la nube de IA han mostrado un fuerte impulso de crecimiento. On May 18, 2026, Shanghai — The evolution curve of AGI in the physical world is being redefined by China's top engineering teams. Today, Matrix Super Intelligence, a hardcore benchmark in the embodied intelligence field, grandly hosted the "2026 Matrix Super Intelligence Technology Day (AI DAY)" at the Zhangjiang Integrated Innovation Park in Shanghai. This is not just a technology showcase but a powerful breakthrough by domestic embodied intelligence toward global top-tier standards. Led by Zhang Haixing, former founding leader of Tesla China Design and Research Center, the "engineering dream team" deeply understands the underlying logic of transitioning from laboratories to large-scale industrialization. The team does not blindly pursue single metrics but adheres to first principles. Through systematic reconstruction of core joints, the dexterous hand MATRIX HAND, and the generalized brain, they have created a "Chinese Optimus" that can truly work and compete globally. On-site, the MATRIX-3 all-purpose flagship humanoid robot stunned the audience with its impressive real-world operations, declaring the perfect integration of its "digital brain" and "strong body."  

Technical Breakthrough: Deep Integration of Generalized Brain and Strong Body  
In product iteration and technological breakthroughs, any grand vision requires down-to-earth progress. From the first-generation engineering validation machine proving the feasibility of full direct-drive joints and demonstrating China's independent robot development capabilities to the world, to the newly released MATRIX-3, the series has undergone a significant leap in size and design philosophy. The newly unveiled MATRIX-3 stands 170 cm tall and weighs 65 kg, designed to closely match human proportions.
excerpt_i18n.es: 18 de mayo de 2026, Shanghái — La curva evolutiva de la AGI en el mundo físico está siendo redibujada por los principales equipos de ingeniería de China. Hoy, Matrix Superintelligence, un referente duro en el campo de la inteligencia encarnada, celebró con gran éxito el "2026 Matrix Superintelligence Tech Day (AI DAY)" en el Parque de Innovación Integrada de Zhangjiang, Shanghái. No se trata solo de una exhibición tecnológica, sino de un poderoso avance de la inteligencia encarnada nacional hacia los estándares globales de primer nivel. Liderado por Zhang Haixing, exdirector fundador del Centro de Diseño e Investigación de Tesla China, el "Equipo de Ensueño de Ingeniería" comprende a fondo la lógica subyacente de pasar del laboratorio a la industrialización a gran escala. El equipo no persigue ciegamente indicadores únicos, sino que se adhiere a los principios fundamentales, insistiendo en los núcleos clave.
